title: the hospital's install path, audited for steps a hospital should not meet

findings.claim: the box form has no field for the mail relay or the trial office's SAE mailbox: tools/box/plan.py:587-588 writes smtp_host and imap_host empty, so mail stays closed until someone edits deploy/.env by hand (section 1.4 row 54)
findings.fix: a wizard field for each (card HS-4)
findings.from: lane U's audit, read in code; no install was run

findings.claim: the first-run page says the data source is connected 'on the box after sign-in' (services/console/i18n_firstrun.py:50); no console page connects a research database, own database, hospital feed or SS-MIX2 folder, which is done by command (RUNBOOK §1 step 4, §18) (row 55)
findings.fix: the placeholder source for a PoC (HS-9); the SS-MIX2 step of 10K-16; until then the help text says what is true
findings.from: lane U's audit, read in code; no install was run

findings.claim: deploy/install.sh asks for answers mid-way, after a 10 to 20 minute bundle load: ClinicalTrials.gov (:461), the TLS name (:566), the SAE mailbox (:591) and 'Start the stack now?' (:818) (rows 15 to 18)
findings.fix: no terminal read after the start in box mode (HS-3)
findings.from: lane U's audit, read in code; no install was run

findings.claim: the finish gate refuses after the bundle is loaded and asks for hand edits of deploy/.env (deploy/install.sh:810; deploy/box-install.sh:269, which then needs a typed --firstrun) (rows 19, 60)
findings.fix: the values asked and checked in the wizard before apply; the gate's refusal before the load (HS-3, HS-4)
findings.from: lane U's audit, read in code; no install was run

findings.claim: nearly every stop line of the deploy scripts is English only and names a setting, a path, a RUNBOOK section or a D number; only four lines of deploy/install.sh are in three languages (:158, :869, :1071, :1074) (row 28)
findings.fix: message keys in en, ja and zh-TW with one action; detail to the install log (HS-5)
findings.from: lane U's audit, read in code; no install was run

findings.claim: the site time zone must agree in four places (settings.yaml, deploy/.env, the mapping, the host; tools/trialbox/doctor.py:875) while the host's zone is detected and still asked (tools/settings_wizard.py:63, tools/box/plan.py:617) (rows 37, 63)
findings.fix: the zone from the host, confirmed once (HS-2, HS-4)
findings.from: lane U's audit, read in code; no install was run

findings.claim: doctor has no default settings files: a bare 'trialbox doctor' judges only the exported TB_* variables (tools/trialbox/__main__.py:64, tools/trialbox/doctor.py:2274); pyproject.toml installs no trialbox command (row 38)
findings.fix: a trialbox command that finds deploy/.env and deploy/settings.yaml itself (HS-10)

findings.fix: one instruction on the hospital's page (HS-7)
